title: Kit Installation Labor — Alignment Services & Plans Adjustment Parts
content:
Alignment Services & Plans charges kit installation labor when adjustment parts are installed with an alignment. On the plan's latest work order, kit installation labor is charged as part of the parts charge, by whether the store listed parts and by the alignment type the work order records:

- **25.00** when the store listed parts and the visit's alignment is a thrust or two-wheel alignment;
- **45.00** when the store listed parts and the visit's alignment is a four-wheel alignment;
- **0.00** when the store listed no parts.

| Parts listed | Alignment type | Kit installation labor |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | thrust | 25.00 |
| Yes | two-wheel | 25.00 |
| Yes | four-wheel | 45.00 |
| No | any | 0.00 |

The installation labor is worked out on its own and charged within the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent.

*Hypothetical:* a four-wheel alignment with a cam bolt kit listed carries 45.00 of installation labor in its parts charge; the same alignment with no parts listed carries none.
